title: Comparative Effectiveness Study of Transthoracic and Transesophageal Echocardiography in Stroke
brief_summary: The Comparative Effectiveness Study of Transthoracic and Transesophageal Echocardiography in Stroke (CONTEST) aims at assessing the diagnostic value of transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) and transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) with regards to treatment consequences in patients with acute ischemic stroke.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* acute ischemic stroke or transitory ischemic attack (TIA)
* age ≥18 years
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with already defined stroke etiology and determined secondary prevention treatment strategy prior to echocardiography (e.g. atrial fibrillation, carotid artery stenosis, cervical artery dissection)
study_population: Patients with acute stroke in whom echocardiography is indicated will be studied by TTE and TEE.
